next_step: Closed - lost to OpenAI/Anthropic direct API. Send loss notes to GTM, archive contact, monitor for re-engagement in 6-9 months.
notes:
Summary: Went quiet after procurement review pushed preference to OpenAI/Anthropic for simplicity and brand comfort. Team liked Redwood tech (autoscaling, routing, batching suggestions) but procurement cited integration speed and existing vendor pilots as tie-breakers.

Key quotes: "We need something our product teams can spin up today — brand + docs matter." "Procurement will not sign new enterprise contracts unless there's clear ops cost savings over OpenAI."

Timeline / Activities (bullets):
timeline: 2025-11-05 - Intro call (AE Maya) — discovered use case: in-chat recommendations + support triage
2025-11-19 - Technical deep-dive (SE Diego) — walked through batching, KV cache, latencies; asked about SSO/KMS
2025-12-03 - POC proposal sent (standard dedicated config, 2 GPU nodes) + pricing deck
2025-12-15 - Security intake (customer) started; requested SOC2/ISO docs and network topology
2026-01-12 - Demo of routing/fallback and console (AE + SE) — positive feedback from engineering lead
2026-01-28 - Procurement call (Maya) — procurement expressed preference for existing vendor pilots (OpenAI); asked for faster procurement timeline
2026-02-02 - Follow-up: offered 60-day trial on hosted API and SSO integration plan; legal cadence requested
2026-02-10 - No response to legal/contract follow-ups; procurement confirmed moving forward with direct OpenAI contract (email thread)
crm_notes:
- Champion: engineering lead (Riley Chang) enthusiastic but not authorized to sign.
- Procurement: conservative, favors major brands; quick internal PoC with OpenAI convinced stakeholders.
- Security: asked for detailed audit log flow; we provided SOC2 + KMS integration docs but legal said timeline too long.
- Cost sensitivity: demonstrated Redwood cost-per-token advantages for long-running sessions but procurement focused on dev speed and existing credits with OpenAI.
- Internal friction: CPO left in Jan; losing momentum after their departure.
- Next: close as lost, send loss analysis to growth and product (include notes on why simplicity/brand outweighed technical benefits).
loss_reason: Chose direct OpenAI/Anthropic APIs for perceived simplicity, brand trust, and faster procurement; internal champion left and budget/procurement timelines blocked Redwood enterprise contract.
reengagement_plan: Monitor for contract renewals or quota exhaustion; reach out with focused migration kit and low-friction hosted pilot in 6 months; capture referenceable technical wins vs OpenAI in mid-market retail use cases.
last_touch_summary: Final outreach 2026-02-10 (email). Procurement confirmed selection of direct OpenAI API pilot. No legal counter-offer received. Deal moved to closed-lost.
